The union of the Who's On First region records Wexford (85684967), Carlow (85684975), Kilkenny (85684979), Wicklow (85684999), Laois (85685005), Kildare (85685025), Offaly (85685041), Westmeath (85685075), Meath (85685081), Louth (85685087), Longford (85685091), Dublin (1746652171). A record is assigned to the first-level division GeoNames files the populated places inside its boundary under. For each of the 26 records, at least 99 percent of those places are under one division.
